card.name: Place names of stations and research centers
card.fires_on: The last word of a named facility or place, such as a station, center, observatory or museum, often just before a location like 'in Florida'. Seen in general web text about places and institutions.

modes.label: Facility name then 'in'
modes.description: The word 'in' right after a named institution, leading into its location.
modes.example: Franz Redl at the IBM TJ Watson Research Center<< in>> New York and colleagues at IBM, Columbia

modes.label: Inside place names
modes.description: Part of a station or geographic name, such as a direction or a piece of a Hawaiian name.
modes.example: At the West Palm Beach and Miami<< North>> (Golden Glades) stations, direct

modes.label: Site or center word
modes.description: A word inside a facility name, such as launch site or Research Center.
modes.example: Both of the rocket’s stages would return to the<< launch>> site and touch down vertically, under rocket

card.writes: It seems to push toward place-type nouns such as station, and away from bridges and places.
card.plain: It marks the point in a text where a named station, center or site is being written out.
